inv.desc_en:
✨ Unique Opportunity in the Salamanca District! ✨

I am acquiring a completely new and renovated cabin, located on a very busy avenue, just 6 meters from the Diego de León metro station and 5 meters from Avenida de América, one of the areas with the highest foot traffic in Madrid. ? Price: €500/month? Location: Salamanca District? Condition: New, modern cabin, ready to start working

The cabin has a built-in sink, making it perfect for any type of aesthetic, beauty, or wellness service (nails, eyelashes, massages, facials, etc. ).

The space is cozy, with no direct competition in the area or within the space itself, ideal for developing your activity in a professional, elegant environment with great visibility.
